title: Roman Republic subject backbone: focused review
purpose: Curator-approved local Subject candidates and hierarchy for the revised graph; authority references remain unapproved.
scope: Only the disconnected economic and military branches, periodization branch, and collapsed slavery/labor branches are included. Other legacy subjects require separate review.
rules: The curator approved these local IDs, labels, and parent links for import as candidate Subjects on 2026-11-09.
Legacy QIDs are unverified candidate references, not Subject identities or authority links.
Legacy facet assignments are not Subject properties; periodization is an inquiry topic, not a temporal coordinate.
NARROWER_THAN direction is child to parent. Parent links were proposed from the legacy ontology, not verified library headings.

authorityReview.method: Compared English labels and descriptions with the proposed subject scope. Findings are review guidance, not verified equivalences or approved graph links.
